description: PLA ad request / non-zero-response volume and response rate for a marketplace over a period, grouped by any combination of the dimensions below: supply network, store, page type, page name, device, product category (L1-L5 or the concatenated category path), day of month, or hour of day. Replaces the three single-grain PLA RR reports. Group by category_l1/l2/l3 for category RR, by store_id + category + day + hour for the store-hour eligibility buckets, or by any other dimension mix. Pass a NOT IN ('', 'NA') filter on the grouping column to reproduce the null/blank guards the retired reports hardcoded.

requests.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.requests ELSE 0 END), 0)

responses.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.non_zero_responses ELSE 0 END), 0)

response_rate.selector: SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.non_zero_responses ELSE 0 END) * 100, NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.requests ELSE 0 END), 0))

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM reporting.os_product_ads_filtered_level_report AS r JOIN reporting.clients AS mc ON r.marketplace_client_id = mc.client_id WHERE mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__ ORDER BY __ATTRIBUTES_ORDER_BY__ LIMIT __LIMIT__ OFFSET __OFFSET__;
